intro: The captain died with the map in his head, and the crew were left with a dead man's silence and a living puzzle. Lucky for them he was a paranoid man, and he had the chart tattooed, in pieces, on each of them, the ink raised like sea-itches under salt and grog. The bosun keeps the old ledger below decks, the one the captain trusted more than his eyes; every entry is two strokes of ink, a day and a bell, and the watch-keeper adds nothing else. The mates stand in line for the tattoos to be read, but the captain never taught them how the pieces fit, only that the sea remembers what the skin forgets. Somewhere between the groans of the timbers and the smell of tar, the answer waits for a crew that can finish the captain's habit.
echo: The first of them smoked meat on wooden frames in Hispaniola.

puzzles.title: Walk The Plank
puzzles.flavor: The host was particular about the seating, and more particular still about what each chair was worth.

clues: Miranda sits somewhere to the left of Edmund.
Edmund and Miranda are not neighbours.
Exactly one person sits between Isaac and Miranda.
Isaac sits somewhere between Ivanka and Miranda.
Miranda sits somewhere between Ivanka and Yolanda.

hints: Only one arrangement satisfies every clue; start from whoever has an end seat or a fixed neighbour. Once they're seated, why might the seat numbers matter?
